Note that this is ALL documents including those without access. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Loading Packages
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)   # For ggplot, dplyr, and friends
library(sf)          # For GIS 
library(countrycode) # To add country codes
```

## Global Theme
```{r global-theme, message=FALSE}
viz_theme <- theme_classic() + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, family = "serif"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

transparent <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'), #transparent panel bg
    plot.background = element_rect(fill='transparent', color=NA), #transparent plot bg
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), #remove major gridlines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), #remove minor gridlines
    legend.background = element_rect(fill='transparent'), #transparent legend bg
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill='transparent')) #transparent legend panel
```

## Loading Data
```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
raw_data <- read.csv("data/codebook_1_clean.csv")
included_ma <- read.csv("data/ma_data.csv")
world_map <- read_sf("maps/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp")
```

Limiting data to only documents that are available and cite the associated meta-analysis

```{r cite-confirmed}
ma <- included_ma %>%
  select(ma_id, label) %>%
  rename(ma_ID = ma_id)

# merge labels into coded data for study 1
s1 <- merge(raw_data, ma, by = "ma_ID")

table(s1$cite_conf)
table(s1$context)

s1_include <- s1 %>% 
  filter(cite_conf == "Yes")

table(s1_include$context)

write.csv(s1_include, "data/s1_clean.csv")
```


## Number of documents
```{r quick-descriptives}
## Number of unique documents
length(unique(s1_include$unique_ID))

## confirming only the documents that cite MAs and I have access are in this sample
table(s1_include$cite_conf)
```

## Documents by context
```{r count-by-MA}
table(s1_include$context)

ma_group_cites <- s1_include %>%
  filter(context != "", !is.na(context)) %>%
  group_by(label, context) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = label, names_from = context, values_from = count) %>%
  print()

# Save for a table
write.csv(ma_group_cites, file = "tables/cites_by_ma_table.csv")
```

## ALL Documents by Meta-Analysis
```{r documents-by-ma}
## table
ma_group <- s1_include %>%
  group_by(ma_ID) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  print()

## histogram
ggplot(ma_group, aes(x = factor(ma_ID), y = count, fill = ma_ID)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = 'Number of documents', 
       title = "Number of documents by MA") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) 
```

# Documents by Meta-Analysis and Publication Year
```{r documents-time-visual}
time <- s1_include %>% 
    select(ma_ID, label, unique_ID, pub_date) %>% 
    mutate(pub_date = ifelse(is.na(pub_date), "No Date", pub_date)) %>%
    mutate(ma_date = str_extract(label, "\\b\\d{4}\\b")) %>% 
    group_by(label, ma_date, pub_date) %>%
    summarise(count = n())

label_order <- time %>%
  distinct(label, ma_date) %>%
  arrange(ma_date) %>%
  pull(label)

time$label <- factor(time$label, levels = label_order)

time_viz <- ggplot(time, aes(x = label, y = count)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = as.factor(pub_date)), position = "dodge") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#fb9a99", "#fdc086", "#fee8a9", "#9dc892", "#5690c1", "#beaed4")) +
  viz_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = c(.92, .7)) +
  labs(x = "Meta-Analysis",
       y = "Number of Documents",
       fill = "Document\nPublication") +
  transparent

time_viz

# save image
# ggsave("visuals/doc_over_time.png", time_viz, device = "png", dpi = 600, height = 6, width = 8, bg = "transparent")
```

# Number of citations by MA year
```{r}
ma_time_avg <- time %>% 
  group_by(ma_date, label) %>% 
  summarise(total_count = sum(count), .groups = "drop")

sub_2021 <- ma_time_avg %>% 
  filter(ma_date == "2021")

mean(sub_2021$total_count)

sub_2022 <- ma_time_avg %>% 
  filter(ma_date == "2022")

mean(sub_2022$total_count)

sub_2023 <- ma_time_avg %>% 
  filter(ma_date == "2023")

mean(sub_2023$total_count)

```

# Map Making
```{r building-map}
country$country_code <- countrycode(country$cite_country,
                               origin = "country.name",
                               destination = "iso3c")

world_sans_antarctica <- world_map %>% 
  filter(ISO_A3 != "ATA")

ma_countries_map <- world_sans_antarctica %>% 
  left_join(country, by = c("ISO_A3" = "country_code"))

levels(ma_countries_map$count_category)

table(ma_countries_map$count_category, useNA = "ifany")

ma_countries_map <- ma_countries_map %>%
  mutate(count_category = case_when(
    is.na(count)          ~ NA_character_,
    count <= 10           ~ "0-10",
    count <= 20           ~ "11-20",
    count <= 30           ~ "21-30",
    count <= 50           ~ "31-50",
    count <= 100          ~ "51-100",
    count > 100           ~ "100+")) %>%
  mutate(count_category = factor(count_category,
                                 levels = c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", 
                                            "31-50", "51-100", "100+")))

all_levels <- c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-50", "51-100", "100+")

ma_countries_map <- ma_countries_map %>%
  mutate(count_category = factor(count_category, levels = all_levels))

# Create a blue palette from light to dark starting with #caeaff
green_palette_fun <- colorRampPalette(c("#e9f3e7", "#589149"))
green_palette <- green_palette_fun(6)
names(green_palette) <- c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-50", "51-100", "100+")

ma_map <- ggplot(ma_countries_map) + 
  geom_sf(aes(fill = count_category), color = "gray", linewidth = 0.25, 
          show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = green_palette, na.value = "white", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(fill = "Number of Documents") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") + 
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", family = "serif"))

ma_map
```
